verdict.rationale: SES supports multiple domain/email identities with separate verification (docs-5, docs-21, docs-35) and IAM-based access control (docs-16), plus dedicated IPs to control reputation (docs-11, docs-26) and configuration sets for tracking/tagging (docs-29). However, there is no evidence of native subaccounts or subusers, and SES suppression lists are account-level (not per-domain/tenant isolated), so true multi-tenant isolation requires building it yourself. Missing for 10: dedicated subaccount/subuser primitives, per-tenant/per-domain suppression list isolation, and per-tenant reputation isolation documentation.
